summary: Describes NPTv6, a stateless way to swap one IPv6 network prefix for another as packets cross a boundary. Each inside address maps one-to-one to an outside address, giving some of the address independence of IPv4 NAT while keeping end-to-end reachability at the network layer. It is an Experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: When mail leaves a building, the street part of the address is changed but the apartment number stays the same. This does that for IPv6 addresses, so a network can change its outside prefix without renumbering everything inside.
